profile.headline: Helping lead Ai @ B3 🚀 Coinbase alumni
profile.summary:
I create solutions for companies, using any and every piece of technology at my disposal - to build as fast as possible. The end result is a plethora of mobile apps, websites & ideas that i've either been contracted to build or did so out of sheer curiosity. 

Things I enjoy:

- Building products from inception
- Clean code
- UX transitions that feel natural when experienced for the first time
- Helping younger generations in tech by sharing what i've learned
- Working with anyone who loves what they do

"What are you going to do in 10 years, when the internet isn't around"
- My mom, circa 2003, when I told her I was dropping out of school. 

Suffice to say, I was 12 years old, had no "backup plan" and had just gotten my first computer, thanks to grandma. 

...brb, actually... I should go thank grandma...

positions.title: Founder & Head of Engineering
positions.description:
For Makers by Makers, at its core, is a team of people who love to create (“Makers”). We make things for ourselves, at our homes and at the office. We create because our curiosity leaves us no choice.

Our mission is to empower not only businesses, but other Makers, to build better products, using the technology we create. Allowing them to focus on the problem they are trying to solve.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mobile Nations started as a client of mine, who's team I had grown to love, while operating ModernvB. After single-handedly running ModernvB for over a decade, I decided it was time for me to learn more about how larger teams operate internally, if I was ever going to build one myself. It was an easy transition and obvious opportunity for everyone to learn and grow together.

Mobile Nations owns and operates some of the largest online publications, including Android Central, iMore, Windows Central and CrackBerry. We see 45M unique visitors per month across our communities.

- Designed, developed & launched the original "Deals" platform for Thrifter
- Designed & Developed "Answers": a Q&A App used among all community properties in order to provide a platform for our users to easily seek help, while rewarding & gamifying the process.
- Engineered a caching system that reduced load times by 25%
- Worked on Ui/UX consistently across all communities, bringing more modern practices to all of their publications (cross-platform compatibility, responsive design, etc)
- Worked closely with Head of Product & QA team during product releases to ensure consumer demands were met across all components. Often taking lead where needed and involving myself on the product side.

positions.title: Founder & Head of Engineering
positions.description:
ModernvB (formerly ProvB) started off as a mere hobby for helping online communities (I was already a part of) implement new technologies that they simply couldn't afford. As a kid who wouldn't take no for an answer, when these communities told me that they couldn't fund the implementation of new technologies and features I wanted, I decided to learn how to program and implement them myself. Simply put: If i was 13 when Facebook was young and broke, I would have coded a "dislike" button for them free of charge. Just because I wanted it done. Never would I have imagined that obsessive desire to create [awesome products] and solve problems would have spiraled into an actual business.

Needless to say, other communities took notice of my work and soon I had a full-blown SaaS business. I ended up writing software that's been used by over 900 online communities and loved by millions of consumers worldwide.

- Developed & Designed 12 SaaS products
- Implemented a freemium model & marketing strategy that eventually led to sales of over 1,000 licenses sold to over 900 websites (used by millions of consumers)
- Ran business development to turn SaaS customers into large contracts (custom software design & development, mobile apps, web apps, etc.)

projects.title: Thrifter
projects.description: Over the course of a 3-day hackathon, I designed & developed a proprietary deals system for Thrifter, which would go on to become the core of its business.

projects.title: Practice on Fire - iOS & Android App
projects.description: Developed a mobile application (iOS & Android) for a respected conference in the dental community to to provide value to their audience year-round.
